data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English name Pierce, which was derived from the Latin name Percival or Percivius. This name means 'Son of Percival' or 'Son of Percivius'. Percival was a legendary knight of King Arthur's Round Table. The name became popular in England during the Middle Ages. The name Pierson carries the meaning “Son of Pierce” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Pierson usually hope their child will grow to embody son of pierce and live with faith, good character and purpose.
